edges.reason: msg.sender is the buyer paying for tickets and becomes the owner of the created tickets.
msg.sender must equal the ticket owner and receives the claimed reward.
msg.sender supplies the injected DEXToken funds.
_msgSender returns msg.sender to the Ownable logic.
buyTickets gates purchases using block.timestamp against the lottery endTime.
closeLottery requires block.timestamp to be greater than the lottery endTime.
startLottery validates _endTime minus block.timestamp against min/max lengths.
The notContract modifier requires msg.sender == tx.origin on buyTickets.
The notContract modifier requires msg.sender == tx.origin on claimTickets.
_lotteryId selects which lottery is being purchased in buyTickets.
_ticketNumbers are validated and stored as purchased tickets.
Each element of _ticketNumbers is read into thisTicketNumber in the loop.
_ticketIds drive the claim loop in claimTickets.
_brackets are validated and used to compute rewards in claimTickets.
_amount is transferred into the contract and added to the lottery pool.
_endTime is validated and stored in the new Lottery struct.
_randomGeneratorAddress is probed and assigned to randomGenerator.
_tokenAddress is the token recovered by the owner.
_newOwner replaces _owner in transferOwnership.
amountDexTokenToTransfer is the value passed to the ERC20 transfer call.
rewardInDexTokenToTransfer is the value sent to the claimer.
buyTickets computes amountDexTokenToTransfer from the bulk price calculation.
buyTickets assigns each ticket number to thisTicketNumber inside the loop.
claimTickets accumulates rewards into rewardInDexTokenToTransfer.
claimTickets reads each ticket id into thisTicketId.
claimTickets delegates reward computation to _calculateRewardsForTicketId.
buyTickets calls _calculateTotalPriceForBulkTickets to price the purchase.
calculateTotalPriceForBulkTickets forwards to the internal price computation.
drawFinalNumberAndMakeLotteryClaimable stores the fetched finalNumber locally.
drawFinalNumberAndMakeLotteryClaimable tracks winners already counted per bracket.
drawFinalNumberAndMakeLotteryClaimable computes the winners pool amount.
drawFinalNumberAndMakeLotteryClaimable accumulates the treasury amount.
drawFinalNumberAndMakeLotteryClaimable derives the transformed winning number.
dexTokenToken is the ERC20 contract invoked by safeTransfer.
treasuryAddress is the recipient of the treasury transfer.
randomGenerator is the external contract whose getRandomNumber is called.
currentLotteryId is incremented and used to index the new lottery.
currentTicketId is used and incremented for every new ticket.
maxNumberTicketsPerBuyOrClaim bounds the array length accepted by buyTickets.
pendingInjectionNextLottery seeds the new lottery pool and is reset.
_bracketCalculator provides the prefix used to transform ticket numbers.
_lotteries provides statuses, ranges and reward data used during claims.
_tickets provides the ticket owner validated during claims.
_numberTicketsPerLotteryId provides winner counts when drawing the final number.
_userTicketIdsPerLotteryId records each ticket bought by the caller.
owner() returns the stored _owner address.
onlyOwner modifier restricts transferOwnership to the owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts renounceOwnership to the owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts changeRandomGenerator to the owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts recoverWrongTokens to the owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts address configuration to the owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts the ticket limit setter to the owner.
onlyOperator modifier restricts closeLottery to the operator.
onlyOperator modifier restricts the draw function to the operator.
onlyOperator modifier restricts startLottery to the operator.
Ownable owner checks are based on _msgSender.
nonReentrant guard on buyTickets blocks nested reentrant calls.
nonReentrant guard on claimTickets blocks nested reentrant calls.
nonReentrant guard on closeLottery blocks nested reentrant calls.
nonReentrant guard on the draw function blocks nested reentrant calls.
notContract modifier uses _isContract(msg.sender) to reject contract callers.
claim side effects follow an external safeTransfer in claim-like flows; the ERC20 call can execute attacker code.
claimTickets performs an external token transfer that could re-enter the contract.
The treasury token transfer is an external call performed during the draw.
recoverWrongTokens transfers an arbitrary token chosen by the owner.
buyTickets pulls funds with an external safeTransferFrom before finishing state updates.
injectFunds uses an external safeTransferFrom to pull tokens from the caller.
closeLottery makes an external call to the random generator contract.
changeRandomGenerator calls into an owner-supplied external contract.
